statements.text: Admins must export all transactions.
Admins must never export transactions.
Members can see all invoices in the workspace.
Members can only see their own invoices in the workspace.
Failed payments are retried for 3 attempts.
Failed payments are retried for 5 attempts.
Retry failed payments 3 times.
Retry failed payments 5 times.
Tenant acme must retain exports.
Tenant globex must not retain exports.
Users can reset their passwords.
Exports are generated nightly.
In Q1 reports must include refunds.
In Q2 reports must not include refunds.
The export must be encrypted at rest.
The export must not be encrypted at rest so support can read it.
Support agents may view customer emails.
Support agents must not view customer emails.
Exports are available immediately after the request.
Exports are produced by a nightly batch job.
Audit logs must be kept forever.
Audit logs are deleted after 90 days.
Admins can export all rows.
Admins can export only filtered rows.
Staff must not delete invoices after approval.
Staff must not delete invoices after payment.
Only admins may approve refunds.
Managers may approve refunds for their own team.
